summary: The recorded base reproduces the issue-specific control-flow defect: grammar-triggered and environment-forced synchronization call all_reduce for a singleton selected group. The exact candidate adds a world-size guard at that call site, skips singleton collectives, and preserves ReduceOp.MIN on multi-rank groups. This is a full source-level fix for the original contract, with the reporter's NVIDIA allocation signature remaining unavailable in the review environment.

tests.what_was_measured: At recorded base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365, grammar-triggered and forced-sync singleton cases each called all_reduce once; the inactive case did not. See raw/base-reproduction.log.
At exact candidate cf963c0763d40b42918accb80f2c230984f52f2b, all four candidate regression/boundary cases passed. See raw/candidate-pytest.log.

The checked-out sampler source path was confirmed. A real singleton NCCL/RCCL process group on gfx950 skipped a trapped all_reduce and retained token [17]. Mocked sizes 0 and 1 skipped, size 2 called the exact group with ReduceOp.MIN, and empty grammars did not query or reduce. See raw/candidate-adversarial.log.

gpu_execution.evidence: raw/candidate-adversarial.log records AMD Instinct MI350X, capability (9, 5)/gfx950, ROCm 7.2, an actual NCCL-backend world-size-one process group, zero sampler all_reduce calls, and unchanged GPU token [17].

remaining_limitations: Only one assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU was available; the reported 8x NVIDIA B300 DP-attention serving topology was not reproduced.
CUDA 13.0 and NVIDIA NCCL 2.28.9 were unavailable, so the reported 512 MiB NET shared P2P allocation signature was not directly measured.
No full model-serving or multi-rank physical-GPU run was performed; the multi-rank contract was independently checked at the sampler call boundary.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes only Python and report/test files; repository-environment.json identifies no native target for this review.
